steps.name: RED: a workspace member on no team is offered boards that 404
criteria: New feature file crates/foundry-acceptance/tests/features/fix-hide-unreachable-boards.feature, feature tag @fix-hub, scenarios @real-io: a workspace member who belongs to NO team (seeded through the shipped member-invite accept flow, never a direct team_memberships insert) signs in and opens the dashboard

Then neither the dashboard 'Your projects' list nor the rail Board href links to /team/general/project/sandbox, and the no-team empty state is shown (copy along the lines of "You're not on any team yet — ask a workspace admin to add you."); the dashboard still returns 200 with the 'Welcome back, <name>' greeting
Guard scenario (green today, must stay green): the team lead who IS on team general still sees Sandbox listed, the rail Board href is /team/general/project/sandbox, and GET on that href returns 200

Store regression in crates/foundry-store/tests/list_projects_for_workspace.rs: given two teams in one workspace and a user on only one of them, the member-scoped project list returns only that team's projects; a user on no team gets an empty list

RED for the right reason, recorded in the execution log: the no-team scenario fails because Sandbox and the Board href /team/general/project/sandbox ARE rendered (the board itself 404s for that member via resolve_board_project -> is_team_member); the store test fails because the unfiltered query returns the other team's project (or fails to compile only on the new user-id argument — record which)

Committed RED artifacts keep every lane green: the failing scenario is tagged @pending and the failing store test is #[ignore = "fix-hide-unreachable-boards 01-02"]; no production code changes in this step
steps.scenario_name: A workspace member on no team is not offered a board they cannot open
steps.description: Regression-first for the user-approved fix direction 'hide boards you can't open'. The dashboard 'Your projects' list (signin.rs ~412) and the rail Board link (nav.rs resolve_board_href ~193-208) both read Store::list_projects_for_workspace (store lib.rs ~877-891, WHERE p.workspace_id = $1, no membership filter), while the board gate (resolve_board_project -> Store::is_team_member, lib.rs ~1540) is team-scoped. OIDC-provisioned and invite-accepted members get no team_memberships row, so they are shown projects and a Board link that 404. This step proves it at both the acceptance and the store level.

steps.implementation_notes: Seed the no-team member through the shipped invite path (reuse the us-member-invites accept steps, e.g. 'Sam has accepted his member invite and is signed in on ...', or the invite-accept-flow helpers) so the precondition is the real production path that omits team_memberships — a direct team_memberships/workspace_memberships insert would hide the defect. The lead is the bootstrap/team-general member already used by the navigation-bar and dashboard features. Assert on observable HTML (href values, listed project names, empty-state copy) and HTTP status only. The store test may express the member-scoped call with the user id the fix will add; if that makes the RED a compile failure, keep the RED honest by first running against the unfiltered query and recording the wrong row. EXEMPT FROM PARADIGM: single-shot UI flow and a two-team SQL filter; the Rust codebase uses example-based tests by default (CLAUDE.md Development Paradigm), no Hypothesis. Build with CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_BUILD_OVERRIDE_STRIP=false; bound every lane with timeout; clean leftover testcontainers after.

steps.name: GREEN: dashboard and rail list only the projects of teams the user is on
criteria: The dashboard 'Your projects' list and resolve_board_href read a member-scoped project list: projects in the acting workspace whose team the acting user belongs to (JOIN team_memberships on the session user id), same (team_slug, project_slug, name, key_prefix) shape and ORDER BY p.name; no unfiltered workspace-wide project list remains reachable from these two call sites

A member on no team sees the no-team empty state ("You're not on any team yet — ask a workspace admin to add you.") with NO link to /team/general/projects/new; a team member whose teams hold no projects keeps the existing 'No projects yet — create your first project' copy; the 'Welcome back, <name>' greeting is unchanged
The rail Board href falls back to / when the member-scoped list is empty (the existing board_href_for_first_project rule) — never a board the user cannot open
Instance-admin listings (list_projects_for_instance, instance_dashboard.html 'No projects yet.') are untouched and stay unfiltered
@pending removed and #[ignore] removed: the fix-hub scenarios and the store regression are GREEN; the lead guard stays GREEN

keycloak-sso and keycloak-sso-provisioning stay green WITHOUT changing their expectations: evidence — 'arrives signed in to the board' / 'arrive at their board signed in as themselves' assert only a 303 to / and the dashboard greeting (feature_keycloak_sso_provisioning.rs ~507-528, feature_keycloak_sso.rs ~788-868), and seed_team_project's team membership (feature_keycloak_sso.rs ~352-372, used at feature_keycloak_sso_provisioning.rs ~719) is a deliberate Given — the precondition for filing an issue, which the team-scoped gate requires — not a mask of this defect. If any of them turns red, record the evidence before changing an expectation
fmt, clippy -D warnings, check-arch, smoke, store tests, navigation-bar, dashboard-enhancements, member-invite, invite-accept, keycloak-sso lanes and the default lane all pass

steps.implementation_notes: Only two call sites read list_projects_for_workspace (signin.rs ~412, nav.rs ~199); both have the session user id in hand (NavContext::home_for/board_for already take user_id). Prefer making the member scope non-optional at the store boundary (the session user id is a required input) so no future caller can reintroduce the unfiltered dashboard read; the crafter chooses the exact name/signature and updates the existing store test callers. Telling 'on no team' apart from 'on a team with no projects' needs one additional observable fact about the session user's team memberships — crafter's choice of how, but it must not issue an unbounded query per render. The existing empty state hard-codes /team/general/projects/new, which is itself a dead link for a no-team member — it must not render for them. Named faults to seed after GREEN: membership JOIN removed; JOIN on the wrong user id; no-team branch shows the create link; Board href computed from an unfiltered list. CHANGELOG under Fixed. EXEMPT FROM PARADIGM: SQL membership filter and single-shot dashboard render; compensate with the two-team store test plus the existing pure board_href_for_first_project table test. Build with CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_BUILD_OVERRIDE_STRIP=false; bound every lane with timeout; clean leftover testcontainers after.
